record.question: In a conspiracy case under Section 8 of BSA, 2023, a letter written by one conspirator describing the conspiracy is relevant against another conspirator:
options: Only if the recipient replied to the letter
Only if all conspirators were aware of the contents
Even if the other conspirator was ignorant of it, provided it was written in reference to the common intention during the existence of the conspiracy
Only if it was written after the conspiracy ended.
